query: 共晶键合为什么不能施加大的接触力？压力大了会出现什么后果？

evidence:
--[p148]-- Due to the liquid phase formed during the process, high contact force results always in metal squeezing out of the interface, resulting in poor interface layer uniformity as well as contamination of the bond tools and bond chamber. The role of the light contact force required is just to ensure good contact of the two wafers and good contact of the two heaters of the bonder with wafers' back sides.
--[p148]-- Eutectic wafer bonding does not require application of high contact force.

success_criteria: 公式正确且算得 0.04/60×90=0.06，并答出修改注册表后需重启 IO_Service、监控显示约 90 mW/cm²。
evidence:
--[p328]-- 1)Use external measurement tool to measure the real intensity of the new lamp. (For example 90 mW/cm2).
3) Check current Light integrator factor: abLightIntegratorFactor REG\_SZ 0.04 (In this case 0.04)
4) Turn ON UV-lamp and read current Lamp Power (e.g. 60mW/cm²)
--[p329]-- 5) Calculate new value for “LightIntegratorFactor” by using the following formula:
$$
\mathsf { L i g h t l n t e g r a t o r F a c t o r = } \quad \frac { \mathsf { C u r r e n t F a c t o r } } { \mathsf { C u r r e n t L a m p P o w e r } } \quad \times \mathsf { R e a l L a m p P o w e r }
$$
Example (using values from above):
$$
\frac { 0 . 0 4 } { 6 0 \mathsf { m W / c m } ^ { 2 } } \star 9 0 \mathsf { m W / c m } ^ { 2 } = 0 . 0 6
$$
--[p329]-- 6) Change the registry parameter to the calculated value and restart lO\_Serivce to activate the changes.
7) After restarting the lO\_Serivce the monitor signal should show the real value. (\~90mW/cm2).

query: 要做 Au:Ge 共晶键合：先查它的共晶温度和推荐键合温度，再按手册的加热程序要求说明峰值温度应升到多少、最后怎么降温。
source_id: 晶圆键合2-CDA EVG Series Operating instructions _ Manualzz
gold_standard: 第一跳（表 1）：Au:Ge 共晶温度 380℃，推荐键合温度 390℃。第二跳（加热程序）：先升温到低于共晶温度的值并短时保温使上下晶圆受热均匀，再把上下加热器升到超过共晶点 10 - 20°C，即峰值 390 - 400℃，最后冷却到共晶温度以下。整个过程需良好的温度均匀性并避免过冲设定点。
success_criteria: 答出 380℃/390℃ 两值，峰值=共晶点+10~20°C（即 390-400°C），并答出"先低于共晶点保温、后冷却到共晶点以下"的完整温度程序。
evidence:
--[p147]-- Au:Ge | 380℃ | 390℃
--[p148]-- Experimental results showed that good quality interfaces are obtained when temperature is raised to a value lower than the eutectic temperature (heating simultaneously from top/bottom), maintained constant for short time to reach uniform heating of both wafers, than increased again by heating both heaters to a temperature exceeding the eutectic point with $1 0 - 2 0 ^ { \circ } C$ (depending on specific process conditions and on substrates restrictions) followed by cooling down to a temperature below the eutectic temperature.

query: 直接键合、共晶键合、玻璃浆料（glass frit）键合这三种工艺，对表面粗糙度/平整度和颗粒的容忍度有什么差别？逐条给出手册依据。
source_id: 晶圆键合2-CDA EVG Series Operating instructions _ Manualzz
gold_standard: 跨节综合：直接键合靠表面分子间化学键成键，一般要求微粗糙度 <0.5 nm（AFM 在 2×2 μm² 上测 Rms），对表面平整度/粗糙度最敏感；共晶键合因界面经历液相，对表面平坦度不规则、划伤及颗粒的敏感性低于直接键合（金属层可包裹直径小于共晶层厚度的颗粒），但对温度均匀性/控温要求高；玻璃浆料键合对表面粗糙度容忍度高、可承受晶圆高形貌（topography），浆料可丝网印刷或用玻璃预制片。三种工艺的结论都须分别与手册对应章节一致，不得引入手册之外的工艺。
success_criteria: 三种工艺各自结论正确并分别对应 p142-143（<0.5 nm 要求）、p147（共晶液相不敏感）、p146（glass frit 高容忍/高 topography）三处原文依据，无编造工艺。
evidence:
--[p142]-- This is a wafer bonding method in which the adhesion between two surfaces occurs as a result of chemical bonds established between molecules from the two surfaces.
--[p143]-- The general requirement of direct bonding is that surfaces have a microroughness <0.5 nm (in some situations even higher values may be acceptable, depending on process conditions boundaries).
--[p147]-- This is a wafer bonding process which uses as bonding layer an eutectic alloy formed during bond process. Eutectic alloy is formed at the bonding interface in a process which goes through a liquid phase: for this reason, eutectic bonding is less sensitive to surface flatness irregularities, scratches, as well as to particles compared to the direct wafer bonding methods (metal layer can incorporate particles with diameter lower than the eutectic layer thickness).
--[p146]-- Glass frit bonding has a high tolerance to surface roughness and can incorporate high topography of the substrates. Glass frit material can be deposited by screen printing or used as glass preformed sheets.

query: 石英压盘用在 300mm 晶圆上的时候，最大活塞力能给到多少？
source_id: 晶圆键合2-CDA EVG Series Operating instructions _ Manualzz
gold_standard: 应说明该书未涉及 300mm 石英压盘的最大活塞力：手册的 Maximum Piston Force 表只覆盖 200mm / 150mm / 125mm / 100mm / 3in / 2in 六档，石英（Quartz*）仅在 200mm 档给出稳态 10kN、升降温 5kN（150mm 为 8kN/4kN），没有任何 300mm 数据；系统应正确拒答并说明表中不存在该尺寸，同时提醒压盘与 bondchuck 必须匹配、衬底与压盘尺寸不符会导致最大活塞力降低甚至压盘/衬底断裂，不应把其他尺寸数值套用到 300mm。
success_criteria: 明确答出"表中无 300mm 石英数据"并说明表格仅到 200mm，同时不出现编造的 300mm 数值，能提示尺寸不匹配的风险说明。
evidence:
--[p204]-- PressureDisc for | 200mm | 150mm | 125mm | 100mm | 3in | 2in
Quartz* | 10kN | 5kN | 8kN | 4kN | 5kN | 2kN | 3kN | 1kN | 2kN | 0,5kN
--[p204]-- Warning: Bondchucks and pressure discs have to match each other. EV Group recommends using appropriated pressure discs and bondchucks.
Bonding of substrates which do not fit to the specified size of pressure disc and bondchuck results in lower max piston force, bending or breaking the pressure disc or substrate.
